method.primary: All 127 client token gaps per background request, then requests, then 3 repeats; SD across repeats.
method.event: Offset zero is first prefill chunk. Exact background output-token ordinal matched to same-repeat decode-only. Exclude local client intervals touching bundled SSE; retain all chunks in model metrics and all requests in whole-request TPOT.
method.max_client_gap: Mean across requests of the largest observed SSE token-event arrival interval; bundled events do not resolve individual model-step gaps.
method.limitations: Fixed budget 2048; 3 repeats; single RTX 4090/Qwen; one 256+32 interference per 128-output background request. Windows [0,0], [0,3], [0,7], [0,15] fixed before collection; report missing intervals without imputation. GPU sampling cannot resolve individual short steps.

small-prefill.batch_zero_policy: prefill-only full/append; no decode baseline or decode TPOT
small-prefill.replicate_aggregation: mean TPOT across background decode requests within each trial
small-prefill.cache_isolation: independent cache_salt for each role/trial; same logical prompts across three scenarios within a repeat/batch
small-prefill.clock: time.perf_counter_ns; same dcn10 kernel as scheduler trace
small-prefill.failure_policy: retain all raw evidence; finish in-flight requests, stop on failed trial; no retry
small-prefill.http_connections: force_close=True; a fresh TCP connection for every request avoids stale keep-alive reuse
small-prefill.artifact_persistence: buffer during active inference; flush after all in-flight requests finish
